_readme: Streams to TRY. Nothing here is in the game until tools/radio/verify-stations.mjs --write has opened the stream and found real audio. Entries are public listening streams the stations publish; confirm each station's streaming terms before adding it. Fields: id (lowercase, a-z 0-9 -), name, country, city, genre, url (https), homepage.
nigerian_stations_to_add: These have NO URL yet on purpose: stream URLs must be copied from each station's own website (or looked up on radio-browser.info, which lists community-reported streams), then listed under candidates and verified. Good ones to look for: Cool FM (Lagos), Wazobia FM, Nigeria Info FM, Beat FM, Raypower FM, Classic FM, Naija FM, Rhythm FM, and Ile-Ife / Osun stations such as Oodua-area community and campus radio. Prefer https streams.
